title: Claim Ledger production restore contract
notes: Permanent contract for restoring Claim Ledger/claim-number onto current live production without replacing newer production-only members. Settlement RPC is required only when write-claim-settlement.mjs is already in the composition.
invariants: linked claim-number save uses UPDATE on the existing claim UUID
no claim INSERT occurs from claim-number editing
existing settlement RPC remains available when the settlement writer is already present
